blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Insert extra comfort here. This bundle…
blocks_element.text:
Insert extra comfort here. This bundle includes Down and Down Alternative options for cloud-soft comforters and pillows, and pillow protectors to extend the life of your pillows. You can create a space that is suited for your ideal relaxation with customizable plushness and warmth.

Choose from Down or Down Alternative: Down is filled with premium, high-grade Down clusters and feathers, and Down Alternative is filled with premium, high-grade hypoallergenic recycled poly microgel that mimics the feel of down. Available in three levels of plushness, each one features details we agonized over: a perfect, no-bunch fit; easy-to-tie loops; quiet sateen shell; and incomparable support.
